name: agent_report
description: File a structured report as a durable, journaled fact: PROGRESS (rolling status), CHECKPOINT (resumable synthesis of everything so far — supersedes prior checkpoints), or FINAL (the deliverable summary; file one before finishing). Reports feed the coordinator's roster and seed projections. Session-dir plan files (*.plan.md) are stamped as artifact manifests automatically on every report.

covers_through_seq.description: Event-log compression hint: faithfully covers all events with seq <= covers_through_seq, so late joiners may start from the latest SCOPE_CHECKPOINT instead of replaying everything.

publish_paths.description: Cell-local file paths (relative to the working directory) to publish as artifacts alongside this report, in addition to the automatic *.plan.md manifest stamping. Runner-read and uploaded; size-capped

scope.description: Report scope: SCOPE_PROGRESS (rolling status), SCOPE_STEP (one step's wrap-up), SCOPE_CHECKPOINT (resumable synthesis; supersedes prior checkpoints), SCOPE_FINAL (the deliverable summary)

artifact_ids.description: Plan-manifest artifacts stamped by this report (session-dir *.plan.md files, content-addressed)

journaled.description: The report is a durable journaled fact
